Question: If Tamilians can learn English happily, why are they disinclined to learn Hindi?
Answer: Few years ago , I was travelling in a public transport by sitting near a lady who was probably from a Hindi speaking state. Back then I was trying to learn French from Duolingo :p so I was solving few lessons by sitting near her. And this lady sitting near me says “ these madrasi learns all languages except for Hindi ” in hindi itself thinking that I don't know Hindi. So I asked her for how many years she lived in Tamil Nadu here and asked whether she learnt Tamil. This lady despite being in Tamilnadu for more than 7 years didn't learn Tamil. I just thought the about the audacity of her to say me such a thing while staying in my home state itself. The thing is many keyboard warriors online like you argue things like why can't you learn Hindi when you are learning English. But the irony is they themselves type this in english. English is almost an universal language, and it's being used in schools, colleges and it helps us in finding job opportunities. I learnt Hindi as a second language but in day to day life I almost never use Hindi in my state. So why do a common people need to learn Hindi just for the sake of learning it. They don't have to learn Hindi just because it makes them patriotic. Even the languages like Telugu, kannada, Tamil, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia ,Tulu or let it be any other Indian languages spoken here , they are also Indian languages, they make them equally patriotic towards the country. And I don't say one must not learn Hindi at all. One can learn Hindi if they want to or if it's necessary for them. But one should not complain others like that lady. Sreeranganathan temple

Question: Have you ever experienced something you can't explain?
Answer: It was quite a busy day for me and I was burnt out from the assignments and was awake till 3 am but I was not sleepy because of the black coffee I had at around 12:30 am but it almost felt like my brain was really exhausted and wanted to doze off right at my bed in my study room. But we have a rule in our house. My family ( of 4 members — parents, my younger brother and my self. ) we all sleep together in same room for safety reasons and it would also be easy for our parents to look at us quite often during night. So I held my self together switched off the my gadgets , lights and went straight to our bedroom. Our bedroom has a large bed where 4 members can sleep together but to sleep freely myself or my mom sleeps in another bed and we sleep in a bed near the wall I went straight to the bed, securing myself a spot near the wall by kicking my brother who sleeps by spreading his legs wide and stole bedsheet from him and closed my eyes. But I was frequently getting the visions of a ghostly figure probably from the Japanese horror movie which I saw earlier , but I told my self it's not real and went to sleep. Suddenly I woke up after few minutes, to the sound of my room door opening and the I saw my brother and my father leaving the room for may be using washroom in the living room , I was quite confused because we already had an attached restroom in our room. Initially I didn't care much but they started talking and laughing loudly and it was quite frustrating for me and I was quite pissed of because they didn't close the door properly , the light was visible due to which I wasn't able to sleep and the intensity of the sound kept on increasing louder and louder . At some point I realised it wasn't my father's voice so I tried calling out my brother's name. To my horror nothing was coming out of my mouth , the laughing from the living room gave me eerie feeling and I knew that something was not right and I thought I had to call my mom but I was not able to move any muscles of my body. I knew that I was experiencing sleep paralysis, but to come out of sleep paralysis I tried to strain my muscles to move but it felt like my body was fixed in a concrete. . With all my effort I tried to call mom but couldn't utter a single word . Suddenly I was able to hear the loud snores near me and I suddenly realised that my father or brother never went outside in the first place and they were asleep all the time. This realisation bought me back to my senses and finally I was able to move again.I immediately shifted from that place near wall and slept btw my brother and my father. Again my eyes were wide open and I woke up to the snores of my brother who was sleeping beside me. But I noticed the fact that he was on left side of me but I remember him staying right when I closed my eyes a while ago and he never snores , again everything resets and I found myself near the wall , again not able to move my self and but I was conscious and was able to see all the stuffs and even minute details of our room but still found myself immobile and trying to move my body part. Then I was finding hard to breathe and was able to look at the weird disorted figures from the window right ahead of me , I just wanted to stay near my mom to feel safe. I tried to move my limbs really hard and I finally overcame the sleep paralysis and I walked straight to my mother sleeping who was sleeping near in the next bed. I slept peacefully near my mom only to wake up once again to find my self in the same position near the wall. It almost felt like everything was reset once again whenever I came out my sleep paralysis and I found my self in the same position near the wall . That's when I realised that I hallucinated the whole time thinking that I came out the sleep paralysis and my hallucinations felt real. I was able to feel , hear and see my exact room . This time I found myself alone on the bed and it was really hard to move this time and all I could do was to blink my eyes and look at the surrounding. Later I don't remember how but I found myself at the edge of the bed some how ( I forgot many hallucinations and the dream which I dreamt during the hallucinations but I knew I did hallucinate of escaping this matrix countless number of times.) I knew that this would be my last chance to escape this endless matrix and tried to roll my body ( as my limbs were not moving) , from bed to ground to reach my mom. I fell down from my bed and was feeling immense pain but still I was happy that I finally reached my mother for real and was telling myself how weird and scary the whole experience was , it almost felt like I was straight out of a horror story. I slept peacefully . Suddenly I remember vividly about a beautiful lady who was talking something in a very different language to me about something and I remember touching her only to wake up. I Woke up again at the same place near the wall but this time I felt my brother hugging me tightly and I was able to move my body now , I tried to sleep between my father and my brother and hugged my father tightly but still I couldn't say if it was a reality or a mere hallucination . The reality felt warped for me . I couldn't distinguish between the dream and reality. But I noticed something, it wasn't even my father who was near me. It was my mother who was sleeping with me and my brother and my father sleept in other bed that day. Now I completely went insane. I tried to calm myself by recalling each and every incident so that I don't forget when I wake up and tried to conclude that it was a dream by some contradicting some small error or bugs in my previous hallucinations, like I found that wall of the living room white from the half open door at the beginning but in reality it was blue. The second thing was the window , the windows in my dream didn't had screen on them. While I was thinking, My mother sleeping beside opened her eyes and looked at me face to face and gave me a smile and asking me if I completed the assignment. Now I was finally relieved , I know that it's the true world and I just started crying and my mom calmed me down , mean while my father woke to check at me. Finally I went out with my parents to get some fresh air at early morning 4:00 am and finally got some peaceful sleep. To this date I couldn't believe that I actually experienced it , as I always believed that hallucinations, sleep paralysis never existed in real life. This is a real experience and nothing was fabricated to extend the story line. I actually wanted to add much more details to my experience but I feel like this is already a huge answer. Question: What are pros and cons of Indian Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme?
Answer: Sovereign gold bond was introduced by Reserve Bank of India to reduce the country's reliance on imported gold. Sovereign gold bonds enables investors to buy gold in the form of bonds. Since it was initiated by the government to promote gold investment , investing on it is safe. So why should we buy gold in the form of bonds rather than real gold ? Bonds can be stored easily and the cost of storage is negligible. One doesn't need to worry abt the theft of it . There is no GST while buying and selling bonds and there is no capital gain tax on the redemption of Sovereign Gold Bonds. It also provides an annual interest of 2.5% to the investors. It can also be used as a collateral for loans just like a real gold. But It has long maturity period of 8 years and cannot be sold in short periods of time unlike real gold. Many Indian buys gold as an ornament to wear so you can't wear gold bond arround your neck :p
